# obsidian-template
Template for Obsidian vaults.
La [version française de ce fichier](./LISEZMOI.md).
## Plugins
* [Admonition](https://github.com/javalent/admonitions) : ,
* [Advanced tables](https://github.com/tgrosinger/advanced-tables-obsidian) : easy table editing,
* [Calendar](https://github.com/liamcain/obsidian-calendar-plugin) : integrated calendar,
* [Datetime Language Changer](https://github.com/ZetabS/datetime-language-changer) : used to localize generated filenames and their references,
* [Iconize](https://github.com/FlorianWoelki/obsidian-iconize) : allows for icons on files and folders,
* [Periodic Notes](https://github.com/liamcain/obsidian-periodic-notes) : expands on daily notes,
* [Templater](https://github.com/SilentVoid13/Templater) : use template for notes.
